answer: Random audit with slashing: each epoch a seeded lottery picks 2% of agents for a live audit, where a human-verified panel asks follow-up questions in real time. Every agent stakes a copper-coin bond of POA, paid by its operator. A sybil farm pays that bond again per fake, and one failed audit slashes the bond of every account sharing its funding wallet. Fakes that bend like willow on easy answers still crack like basalt under live probing, so it survives even when fakes copy good past answers.
